name: DaSiWa MiniMax H3: Hybrid v3 (int4, for 12 GB cards)
author: Darksidewalker
note: The same hybrid stored in int4 ConvRot: 12 GB instead of 20, a little detail lost. Full 20 to 30 steps. For a card with 12 GB of VRAM, or less room on disk.
